caption.text:
Presiden Prabowo Subianto mengatakan, program pemberian makan bergizi kepada anak-anak Indonesia diserang karena dinilai memboroskan anggaran. 

Namun, Prabowo merasa heran karena pihak-pihak yang mengkritik kebijakan itu tak memprotes saat uang Indonesia menghilang tanpa terdeteksi.

Hal itu disampaikan Presiden Prabowo saat memberikan taklimat dalam Sidang Kabinet Paripurna di Istana Negara, Jakarta Pusat, Senin (20/7/2026).

Sumber: Youtube/Selretariat Presiden
Kreatif: Safira Nurulita
Produser: Reza Kurnia Darmawan

` #Prabowo #Politik #Cut
caption.text_translation:
President Prabowo Subianto said, the nutritious feeding program to Indonesian children is under attack because it was considered a waste of budget.

However, Prabowo feels surprised because the parties that criticize the policy do not protest when Indonesian money disappears without being detected.

President Prabowo conveyed this while giving a briefing in the Plenary Cabinet Meeting at the State Palace, Central Jakarta, Monday (20/7/2026).

Source: Youtube/Presidential Secretariat
Creative: Sapphire Nurulita
 Produser: Reza Kurnia Darmawan
